key.name: points
key.description: Screen brightness (0–1) at 0, 10, 50, 150, 500, 1500 and 3500 lux, before the brightness slider's adjustment; joined by a smooth rising line.

key.name: response
key.description: Seconds to follow a brighter room; a darker room takes three times as long, so a passing hand doesn't dim the screen.

key.name: keyboard
key.description: Turn the keyboard backlight on in the dark and off in bright light.

key.name: keyboard-level
key.description: Keyboard backlight percent when the room is dark. Changing the keyboard brightness while it's on sets this.

key.name: keyboard-off-lux
key.description: Light level in lux above which the keyboard backlight goes off; it comes back on below 70% of it.
